verdict.rationale: BugSnag documents its own tools for retroactively redacting or removing sensitive data to support GDPR/CCPA/HIPAA compliance, which covers deletion. It also offers an on-premise version for organizations that want to manage their own data. Configurable retention periods are not documented, and discard and event-saving controls only govern what is ingested, not how long it is kept. missing for 10: configurable data retention periods/policies, detail on deletion scope and mechanics (e.g., API or user-level deletion), independent or hands-on corroboration.
